data.description:
Not to be confused with Calamitas Clone, a Hardmode boss.
Do you enjoy going through hell?— Supreme Witch, Calamitas
Supreme Witch, Calamitas is a major boss intended to be fought after defeating Yharon, Dragon of Rebirth, and around the same time as the Exo Mechs. She is currently one of the most challenging...

<blockquote class="quotation"><div class="m nomobile">“</div><div class="c"><p style="margin-bottom: 0;">Do you enjoy going through hell?</p><p style="float: right;">— Supreme Witch, Calamitas</p></div></blockquote>
<p><b>Supreme Witch, Calamitas</b> is a major <a href="/wiki/Boss" class="mw-redirect" title="Boss">boss</a> intended to be fought after defeating <a href="/wiki/Yharon,_Dragon_of_Rebirth" title="Yharon, Dragon of Rebirth">Yharon, Dragon of Rebirth</a>, and around the same time as the <a href="/wiki/Exo_Mechs" title="Exo Mechs">Exo Mechs</a>. She is currently one of the most challenging bosses in the Calamity Mod, and currently acts as the final boss alongside the Exo Mechs.
</p><p>Defeating her provides the player with <a href="/wiki/Ashes_of_Annihilation" title="Ashes of Annihilation">Ashes of Annihilation</a>, a crafting material for various endgame equipment, and also causes her to move in as the <a href="/wiki/Brimstone_Witch" title="Brimstone Witch">Brimstone Witch</a> <a href="/wiki/Town_NPC" class="mw-redirect" title="Town NPC">Town NPC</a>, granting players access to the <a href="/wiki/Enchantment" title="Enchantment">Enchantment</a> mechanic.
</p>

<h2><span class="mw-headline" id="Spawn">Spawn</span></h2>
<p>Supreme Witch, Calamitas does not spawn on her own and requires the player to summon her by using <a href="/wiki/Ashes_of_Calamity" title="Ashes of Calamity">Ashes of Calamity</a> on an <a href="/wiki/Altar_of_the_Accursed" title="Altar of the Accursed">Altar of the Accursed</a>. She can be summoned anywhere at any time. After this, the screen will darken and shake before Supreme Witch, Calamitas herself appears above the Altar. When Supreme Witch, Calamitas is fully summoned, she will laugh devilishly instead of using the regular boss roar.
</p><p>After defeating Supreme Witch, Calamitas, a <a href="/wiki/Ceremonial_Urn" title="Ceremonial Urn">Ceremonial Urn</a> can be crafted, serving as a non-consumable summon item.
</p><p>If the <a href="/wiki/Brimstone_Witch" title="Brimstone Witch">Brimstone Witch</a> NPC is currently alive in the world, she will disappear when Supreme Witch, Calamitas is summoned.
</p>
<h2><span class="mw-headline" id="Behavior">Behavior</span></h2>
<div class="thumb tright"><div class="thumbinner" style="width:202px;"><a href="/wiki/File:Calamitas_Shield.gif" class="image"><img src="/images/Calamitas_Shield.gif?41a152" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="200" height="200" class="thumbimage" data-file-width="200" data-file-height="200"></a>  <div class="thumbcaption"><div class="magnify"><a href="/wiki/File:Calamitas_Shield.gif" class="internal" title="Enlarge"></a></div>The force field of Calamitas.</div></div></div>
<p>Supreme Witch, Calamitas has several powerful attacks that she will switch between in a consistent cycle. She always remains either directly above or to the side of the player, only breaking position during Bullet Hell phases or during her devastating dash attacks.
</p><p>Visually, Calamitas is always protected by a circular red force field, which serves to increase the size of her hitbox.
</p>
<h3><span class="mw-headline" id="Attacks">Attacks</span></h3>
<p>While Supreme Witch, Calamitas is mobile, she will switch between these attacks in a well-defined cycle.
</p>
<ul><li>She condenses her force field into a demonic skull and charges at the player at an incredibly high speed, dealing massive damage. This occurs either 2 or 4 times in a row, depending on the position in the cycle.
<ul><li>At the start of the attack prior to charging, she will become translucent as a warning.</li>
<li>Once she enters her second phase, she will charge half as many times in a row.</li></ul></li></ul>
<ul><li>She attempts to hover above the player, shooting bursts of 8 <span class="i"><img alt="Brimstone Dart" src="/images/thumb/Brimstone_Dart.gif/9px-Brimstone_Dart.gif?8099bf" decoding="async" loading="lazy" title="Brimstone Dart" width="9" height="21" srcset="/images/thumb/Brimstone_Dart.gif/14px-Brimstone_Dart.gif?8099bf 1.5x, /images/Brimstone_Dart.gif?8099bf 2x" data-file-width="18" data-file-height="42"><span><span title="Brimstone Dart">Brimstone Darts</span></span></span> at the player, leaving similar-sized gaps between the projectiles. This is the only occurence of randomness in her attack pattern.</li>

<li>She remains at the player's side and fires a barrage of <span class="i"><img alt="Brimstone Hellblast2" src="/images/thumb/Brimstone_Hellblast2.gif/27px-Brimstone_Hellblast2.gif?242979" decoding="async" loading="lazy" title="Brimstone Hellblast2" width="27" height="21" srcset="/images/thumb/Brimstone_Hellblast2.gif/41px-Brimstone_Hellblast2.gif?242979 1.5x, /images/Brimstone_Hellblast2.gif?242979 2x" data-file-width="54" data-file-height="42"><span><span title="Brimstone Hellblast2">Brimstone Hellblasts</span></span></span>, which accelerate towards the player. She shoots the Hellblasts horizontally once she has taken her position to the left/right of the player - however, she can already start shooting while in the process of homing towards this position. This can cause bullets to fly in non-horizontal directions.</li></ul>
<p><br>
Once she enters her second phase at 40% HP, the delays between her attacks as well as inside her attacks become shorter; she charges more aggressively and only half as often per attack.
</p>
<h3><span class="mw-headline" id="Attack_Cycle">Attack Cycle</span></h3>
<p>Supreme Witch, Calamitas has a constant attack cycle which only interrupts when she is not attacking at all. Neither going through bullet-hell phases, nor switching to her second phase changes the current position in this cycle. It repeats once it is finished.
</p><p>The attack cycle (starting as soon as the first Sepulcher is summoned): 
</p>
<ol><li>Shoots bursts of Brimstone Darts</li>
<li>Shoots a horizontal barrage of Brimstone Hellblasts</li>
<li>Launches 2 Brimstone Gigablasts</li>
<li>Charges 4 times (2 times in the second phase)</li>
<li>Launches 2 Brimstone Gigablasts</li>
<li>Shoots a horizontal barrage of Brimstone Hellblasts</li>
<li>Shoots bursts of Brimstone Darts</li>
<li>Charges 2 times (once in the second phase)</li>
<li>Shoots bursts of Brimstone Darts</li>
<li>Shoots a horizontal barrage of Brimstone Hellblasts</li>
<li>Launches 4 Brimstone Gigablasts</li>
<li>Shoots a horizontal barrage of Brimstone Hellblasts</li>
<li>Charges 2 times (once in the second phase)</li>
<li>Shoots bursts of Brimstone Darts</li>
<li>Launches 4 Brimstone Gigablasts</li>
<li>Charges 4 times (2 times in the second phase)</li>
<li>Shoots bursts of Brimstone Darts</li>
<li>Charges 2 times (once in the second phase)</li>
<li>Shoots bursts of Brimstone Darts</li>
<li>Charges 2 times (once in the second phase)</li></ol>
<p><br>
Note that every time she shoots bursts of Brimstone Darts, some bursts are replaced by Brimstone Fire- and Gigablasts.
</p><p>Since it is a relatively long cycle with multiple occurences of every type of attack, it is time consuming to fully memorize and comprehend it. Whilst it is not necessary to do so, it proves beneficial when playing in harder difficulties and/or with special constraints.
</p>
<h4><span class="mw-headline" id="Progression">Progression</span></h4>
<p>Supreme Witch, Calamitas will perform these attacks once, triggered by her reaching certain amounts of health.
</p>
<ul><li>Upon <b>spawning</b>, she will summon a randomized "Bullet Hell" of vertical and horizontal Brimstone Hellblasts which travel from one edge of the player's screen to the other. She will be invincible and immobile until the Bullet Hell ends. The sequence of the Hellblasts' direction will always be the same during the Bullet Hell: down/right/left simultanously, then left and right, then down/left/right again.<br>After the Bullet Hell ends, she will summon the <a href="/wiki/Sepulcher" title="Sepulcher">Sepulcher</a> at the bottom of the arena before becoming mobile. Ten immobile Brimstone Hearts will spawn along with it, positioned in the upper corners of the arena; the Sepulcher will die once no more Brimstone Hearts remain. The Sepulcher doesn't deal contact damage but instead attempts to charge at Calamitas every few seconds, releasing a dense ring of accelerating Brimstone Darts whenever contacting her. Calamitas will be invincible until the Sepulcher is killed.
<ul><li>While the Sepulcher is alive, Calamitas will shoot slower and only fire half as many projectiles per attack.</li></ul></li>
<li>Upon reaching <b>75% health</b>, the second Bullet Hell triggers, in which Brimstone Fireblasts are also fired at the player from offscreen. This occurs in every Bullet Hell hereafter. The order of the Hellblasts' direction is up, then right, then left and right simultaneously.</li>
<li>Upon reaching <b>50% health</b>, the third Bullet Hell triggers, in which Brimstone Gigablasts are also fired at the player along with the previous projectiles. This occurs in every Bullet Hell hereafter. The order of the Hellblasts' direction is down, then left, then left and right simultaneously.</li>
<li>After the third Bullet Hell, she will clear all her projectiles, teleport above the player and then summon her brothers, Catastrophe and Cataclysm, to assist her, becoming invincible and immobile while they are alive. They both remain a set distance to the left and right of the player, slowly moving up and down while repositioning slightly between attacks. Cataclysm is initially on the right and will fire <span class="i"><img alt="Cataclysm Fist Alt" src="/images/thumb/Cataclysm_Fist_Alt.gif/44px-Cataclysm_Fist_Alt.gif?db1982" decoding="async" loading="lazy" title="Cataclysm Fist Alt" width="44" height="19" srcset="/images/thumb/Cataclysm_Fist_Alt.gif/66px-Cataclysm_Fist_Alt.gif?db1982 1.5x, /images/thumb/Cataclysm_Fist_Alt.gif/88px-Cataclysm_Fist_Alt.gif?db1982 2x" data-file-width="126" data-file-height="54"></span> <span class="i"><img alt="Cataclysm Fist" src="/images/thumb/Cataclysm_Fist.gif/44px-Cataclysm_Fist.gif?fa5488" decoding="async" loading="lazy" title="Cataclysm Fist" width="44" height="19" srcset="/images/thumb/Cataclysm_Fist.gif/66px-Cataclysm_Fist.gif?fa5488 1.5x, /images/thumb/Cataclysm_Fist.gif/88px-Cataclysm_Fist.gif?fa5488 2x" data-file-width="126" data-file-height="54"><span><span title="Cataclysm Fist">fists</span></span></span> at the player, and Catastrophe is initially on the left and will fire <span class="i"><img alt="Catastrophe Top Slash" src="/images/thumb/Catastrophe_Top_Slash.gif/44px-Catastrophe_Top_Slash.gif?4c89e4" decoding="async" loading="lazy" title="Catastrophe Top Slash" width="44" height="13" srcset="/images/thumb/Catastrophe_Top_Slash.gif/66px-Catastrophe_Top_Slash.gif?4c89e4 1.5x, /images/thumb/Catastrophe_Top_Slash.gif/88px-Catastrophe_Top_Slash.gif?4c89e4 2x" data-file-width="192" data-file-height="56"></span> <span class="i"><img alt="Catastrophe Bottom Slash" src="/images/thumb/Catastrophe_Bottom_Slash.gif/44px-Catastrophe_Bottom_Slash.gif?df5103" decoding="async" loading="lazy" title="Catastrophe Bottom Slash" width="44" height="15" srcset="/images/thumb/Catastrophe_Bottom_Slash.gif/66px-Catastrophe_Bottom_Slash.gif?df5103 1.5x, /images/thumb/Catastrophe_Bottom_Slash.gif/88px-Catastrophe_Bottom_Slash.gif?df5103 2x" data-file-width="168" data-file-height="58"><span><span title="Catastrophe Bottom Slash">slashes</span></span></span> at the player. Every few seconds, both brothers will stop in place and fire a barrage of their respective projectiles at the player, before swapping positions. When one of the brothers is reduced below 40% / <b><abbr class="death_value" style="cursor:pointer;" title="Death Mode">60%</abbr></b> <span class="i"><a href="/wiki/Death_Mode" title="Death Mode"><img alt="Death Mode" src="/images/thumb/Death_Indicator_%28borderless%29.png/15px-Death_Indicator_%28borderless%29.png?a97b52" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="15" height="15" srcset="/images/thumb/Death_Indicator_%28borderless%29.png/23px-Death_Indicator_%28borderless%29.png?a97b52 1.5x, /images/thumb/Death_Indicator_%28borderless%29.png/30px-Death_Indicator_%28borderless%29.png?a97b52 2x" data-file-width="46" data-file-height="46"></a></span> health or the other brother is defeated, it will enter phase 2.
<ul><li>If Cataclysm is in phase 2, every third fist will be replaced by two fists aimed around the player's position, its fist barrage becomes faster over time, and it ends the fist barrage by firing a massive energy sphere at the player, which stops in place and fires a stream of fists towards Cataclysm's original position before vanishing. If Catastrophe has been defeated, its double fists have a tighter spread, its fist barrage is even faster, and the energy sphere fires a 3-way spread of fists instead.</li>
<li>If Catastrophe is in phase 2, every third slash will rapidly accelerate, and it ends the slash barrage by lunging ahead of the player's current movement, creating a delayed slice along its path. If Cataclysm has been defeated, its slash attack becomes much faster, and its lunge creates two additional diagonal slices flanking the original.</li></ul></li>
<li>Once both brothers are dead, Calamitas laughs and transitions into her second phase, indicated by a glowing aura around her and her attack animations becoming more pronounced. From now on, she will attack faster, but perform half as many charge attacks in a row. Immediately after transitioning, she will always shoot several bursts of Brimstone Darts before resuming her attack cycle from the last position.</li>
<li>Upon reaching <b>30% health</b>, the fourth Bullet Hell triggers, and Supreme Witch, Calamitas will summon a massive <b>Whispering Maelstrom</b> from the Altar of the Accursed, which moves towards the player at a moderate speed and persists throughout the rest of the fight. The Maelstrom deals massive continuous damage on contact which increases exponentially the closer the player is to the center. The order of the Hellblasts' direction is up, then right, then left and right simultaneously.
<ul><li>During this Bullet Hell and in all following ones, the number of Brimstone Hellblasts is noticeably decreased.</li>
<li>Calamitas' force field becomes noticeably more vibrant from this point on.</li></ul></li>
<li>Upon reaching <b>20% health</b>, she will summon a large rotating ring of 10 <a href="/wiki/Soul_Seeker_(Supreme)" class="mw-redirect" title="Soul Seeker (Supreme)">Supreme Soul Seekers</a> around herself, which fire synchronous volleys of Brimstone Darts at the player. While the Soul Seekers are alive, Calamitas is invulnerable to damage, and the Whispering Maelstrom moves at 80% speed and has increased inertia.</li>
<li>Upon reaching <b>10% health</b>, the fifth and final Bullet Hell triggers, featuring every projectile introduced thus far, with the inclusion of <span class="i"><img alt="Brimstone Flame Skull" src="/images/thumb/Brimstone_Flame_Skull.gif/24px-Brimstone_Flame_Skull.gif?f89dca" decoding="async" loading="lazy" title="Brimstone Flame Skull" width="24" height="16" srcset="/images/thumb/Brimstone_Flame_Skull.gif/36px-Brimstone_Flame_Skull.gif?f89dca 1.5x, /images/Brimstone_Flame_Skull.gif?f89dca 2x" data-file-width="48" data-file-height="32"><span><span title="Brimstone Flame Skull">Brimstone Flame Skulls</span></span></span> which fly in a horizontal wave pattern. The order of the Hellblasts' direction is down, then left and right, then down/left/right simultaneously.
<ul><li>Her damage reduction increases by 20% (from 25% to 30%) for the remainder of the battle.</li></ul></li>
<li>After the final Bullet Hell, she will summon the <a href="/wiki/Sepulcher" title="Sepulcher">Sepulcher</a> and its 10 Brimstone Hearts again. Supreme Witch, Calamitas will once again become invulnerable until its hearts are killed. While the Sepulcher is alive, the Whispering Maelstrom moves at 80% speed.</li>
<li>Upon reaching <b>1 life point</b>, she will lose all her other abilities, the Whispering Maelstrom and all of her projectiles will disappear, she will teleport to the Altar of the Accursed and stop moving, and she becomes invulnerable. After several <a href="/wiki/Status_message" class="mw-redirect" title="Status message">status messages</a> and a delay, Calamitas will vanish in a beam of red light and reappear at the Altar of the Accursed as the <a href="/wiki/Brimstone_Witch" title="Brimstone Witch">Brimstone Witch</a> NPC, leaving her loot at the Altar.</li></ul>
<h3><span class="mw-headline" id="In_Expert_Mode">In <a href="/wiki/Expert_Mode" class="mw-redirect" title="Expert Mode">Expert Mode</a></span></h3>
<ul><li>Brimstone Fireblasts and Gigablasts explode into 12 and 28 Brimstone Darts respectively.</li>
<li>Spawns 11.11% more projectiles during Bullet Hell phases.</li></ul>
<h3><span class="mw-headline" id="In_Revengeance_Mode">In <a href="/wiki/Revengeance_Mode" title="Revengeance Mode">Revengeance Mode</a></span></h3>
<ul><li>Brimstone Fireblasts and Gigablasts explode into 14 and 32 Brimstone Darts respectively.</li>
<li>Massively increased speed and moves far more aggressively.</li>
<li>Spawns 12.5% more projectiles during Bullet Hell phases.</li></ul>
<h3><span class="mw-headline" id="In_Death_Mode">In <a href="/wiki/Death_Mode" title="Death Mode">Death Mode</a></span></h3>
<ul><li>Brimstone Fireblasts and Gigablasts explode into 16 and 36 Brimstone Darts respectively.</li>
<li>Cataclysm and Catastrophe begin attacking much sooner after spawning, and their barrage projectiles travel faster. Cataclysm fires 3 fists in a fan-shaped pattern at the end of a fist barrage, increased to 6 if Catastrophe has been defeated. Catastrophe creates a big slice at the end of a slash barrage, and does it 3 times if Cataclysm has been defeated.</li>
<li>The arena created by Supreme Witch, Calamitas is now 127x127 (inner available area is 125x125) blocks.</li></ul>
<h3><span class="mw-headline" id="In_Master_Mode">In <a href="/wiki/Master_Mode" class="mw-redirect" title="Master Mode">Master Mode</a></span></h3>
<ul><li>When both brothers are killed, the first brother killed will respawn with 65% of its normal health.</li></ul>
<h3><span class="mw-headline" id="During_the_Boss_Rush">During the <a href="/wiki/Boss_Rush" title="Boss Rush">Boss Rush</a></span></h3>
<ul><li>All boss dialogue is omitted and she will always use her hooded appearance.</li>
<li>Significantly increased speed, aggression, and projectile density.</li>
<li>Brimstone Fireblasts and Gigablasts explode into 20 and 44 Brimstone Darts respectively.</li>
<li>Instead of reverting to the Brimstone Witch upon defeat, the player will be prompted to finish her off.</li></ul>
<h3><span class="mw-headline" id="On_the_For_the_Worthy_seed">On the <a href="/wiki/For_the_Worthy" title="For the Worthy">For the Worthy</a> seed</span></h3>
<ul><li>Moves 15% faster.</li>
<li>Spawns up to 33% more projectiles during Bullet Hell phases.</li></ul>
<h3><span class="mw-headline" id="On_the_Get_fixed_boi_seed">On the <a href="/wiki/Get_fixed_boi" title="Get fixed boi">Get fixed boi</a> seed</span></h3>
<ul><li>Cataclysm fires slashes instead of fists, and Catastrophe fires fists instead of slashes.</li>
<li>Catastrophe will indefinitely lunge at the player as soon as it is able to.</li>
<li>Cataclysm fires a <span class="i"><img alt="Basketball" src="/images/thumb/Basketball.png/28px-Basketball.png?ad2f58" decoding="async" loading="lazy" title="Basketball" width="28" height="28" srcset="/images/thumb/Basketball.png/42px-Basketball.png?ad2f58 1.5x, /images/thumb/Basketball.png/56px-Basketball.png?ad2f58 2x" data-file-width="340" data-file-height="340"><span><span title="Basketball">basketball projectile</span></span></span> instead of its energy sphere, which travels quickly and bounces around the arena. It plays <span class="sound" title="Click to play"><span class="sound-title">this sound</span><audio controls="" preload="none" width="320" style="width:320px;max-width:100%;max-height:100%" data-durationhint="1" data-mwtitle="Kickball.ogg" data-mwprovider="local"><source src="/images/Kickball.ogg?b86e53" type="audio/ogg; codecs="vorbis"" data-width="0" data-height="0"><source src="/images/transcoded/Kickball.ogg/Kickball.ogg.mp3" type="audio/mpeg" data-transcodekey="mp3" data-width="0" data-height="0"></audio></span> every time it bounces around the arena.</li>
<li>Whispering Maelstroms have a new <span class="sound" title="Click to play"><span class="sound-title">idle sound</span><audio controls="" preload="none" width="320" style="width:320px;max-width:100%;max-height:100%" data-durationhint="2" data-mwtitle="GFBDrone.ogg" data-mwprovider="local"><source src="/images/GFBDrone.ogg?a598f2" type="audio/ogg; codecs="vorbis"" data-width="0" data-height="0"><source src="/images/transcoded/GFBDrone.ogg/GFBDrone.ogg.mp3" type="audio/mpeg" data-transcodekey="mp3" data-width="0" data-height="0"></audio></span>.</li></ul>

<h2><span class="mw-headline" id="Resistances">Resistances</span></h2>
<ul><li>Brimstone Hearts take reduced damage from most non-<a href="/wiki/Minion" class="mw-redirect" title="Minion">minion</a> <a href="/wiki/Pierce_resistance" title="Pierce resistance">piercing projectiles</a>. Each hit decreases the damage of the next hit by 12%, until the eighth hit onwards which deal 20% of the original damage.</li>
<li>Brimstone Hearts also take:
<ul><li>70% damage from <a href="/wiki/Surge_Driver" title="Surge Driver">Surge Driver</a>'s comet and <a href="/wiki/Supernova" title="Supernova">Supernova</a>'s stealth strike explosion.</li>
<li>66% damage from <a href="/wiki/Celestus" title="Celestus">Celestus</a>' mini scythes.</li></ul></li>
<li>Supreme Soul Seekers take:
<ul><li>75% damage from <a href="/wiki/Yharim%27s_Crystal" title="Yharim's Crystal">Yharim's Crystal</a>.</li>
<li>70% damage from <a href="/wiki/Zenith" class="mw-redirect" title="Zenith">Zenith</a>.</li>
<li>60% damage from Supernova's stealth strike explosion and <a href="/wiki/Subsuming_Vortex" title="Subsuming Vortex">Subsuming Vortex</a>.</li>
<li>20% damage from <a href="/wiki/Chicken_Cannon" title="Chicken Cannon">Chicken Cannon</a>'s explosion.</li></ul></li></ul>
<h2><span class="mw-headline" id="Aftermath">Aftermath</span></h2>
<ul><li>The <a href="/wiki/Brimstone_Witch" title="Brimstone Witch">Brimstone Witch</a> <a href="/wiki/NPC" class="mw-redirect" title="NPC">NPC</a> becomes available, unlocking the <a href="/wiki/Enchantment" title="Enchantment">Enchantment</a> system.</li>
<li>Plays a full, long-fade variant of "Stained, Brutal Calamity (Acceptance)" <a href="/wiki/Music" title="Music">music</a> when defeated for the first time.</li>
<li>In subsequent rematches, she will appear unhooded and will use a different set of dialogue lines.</li></ul>
<h2><span class="mw-headline" id="Notes">Notes</span></h2>
<ul><li>Each Bullet Hell segment lasts for 15 seconds.</li>
<li>Supreme Witch, Calamitas only deals contact damage while charging.</li>
<li>Only Catastrophe's slashes deal <a href="/wiki/Defense_damage" title="Defense damage">defense damage</a>, while only Cataclysm's fists inflict Vulnerability Hex.</li></ul>
<h2><span class="mw-headline" id="Tips">Tips</span></h2>
<dl><dd><i>For more elaborate strategies on defeating Supreme Witch, Calamitas, including <a href="/wiki/Weapon" class="mw-redirect" title="Weapon">weapon</a> and <a href="https://terraria.wiki.gg/wiki/Guide:Arena" class="extiw" title="tgc:Guide:Arena">arena</a> recommendations, see <a href="/wiki/Guide:Supreme_Witch,_Calamitas_strategies" title="Guide:Supreme Witch, Calamitas strategies">Guide:Supreme Witch, Calamitas strategies</a>.</i></dd></dl>
<ul><li>Making an arena can potentially increase mobility, which is useful for dodging Supreme Witch, Calamitas' fast attacks.</li>
<li>Calamitas' dash is fast and can sometimes deal fatal damage, so it's recommended to attack with weapons that have decent range and/or homing ability which will make it easier to dodge her dashes. Watch for her tell when she's about to use it as her next attack.</li>
<li>Don't bother trying to attack Calamitas during the Bullet Hell phases or when the <a href="/wiki/Sepulcher" title="Sepulcher">Sepulcher</a> and its Brimstone Hearts are still alive. She will be immune to damage during them.</li>
<li>Try to master the first Bullet Hell phase. The projectiles are significantly denser in this phase compared to the others, so it's better to take as little damage as possible in the first attack.</li>
<li>During the first Bullet Hell phase, do not panic and move about too much as the blasts in this phase are extremely deadly and occasionally spawn in groups. Getting hit during this phase could potentially lead to the player's early demise.</li>
<li>During Bullet Hell phases, it's good in some cases to stick to a wall when the projectiles are only moving from one side, as it may be easier to dodge them. Be sure to watch out for the Fireblasts and Gigablasts that home in on the player.</li>
<li>It is recommended to move vertically before a bullet hell ends to prevent getting hit by Supreme Witch, Calamitas' projectiles as she resumes her attacks.</li>
<li>Fly in the direction of the Brimstone Hellblasts Supreme Witch, Calamitas spawns during her Bullet Hell phases and be sure to <i>fly slowly</i>. This will help prevent the player from being hit by unnoticed projectiles or dashing/running into them.</li>
<li>If Supreme Witch, Calamitas' brothers are alive and the player is at low health, it may be advisable to delay attacking the brothers and heal. Especially when only one is alive, many of the projectiles are simple to dodge, so it may prove as a good opportunity to regenerate health or even wait for <a href="/wiki/Rage_Meter" title="Rage Meter">Rage</a> or <a href="/wiki/Adrenaline_Meter" title="Adrenaline Meter">Adrenaline</a> to charge up in Revengeance Mode.</li>
<li>If the player is confident in their ability to avoid damage, it's helpful to save up Rage or Adrenaline specifically for the phases where Supreme Witch, Calamitas summons minions in order to end the phases quickly. Using them on Supreme Witch, Calamitas herself will often result in her going invulnerable and progressing to the next phase, wasting much of the increased damage.</li>
<li>At the end of each Bullet Hell phase, all of Supreme Witch, Calamitas' projectiles spawned during the phase will fade out and disappear. While fading out, these projectiles will not deal damage.</li>
<li>Defeating the <a href="/wiki/Exo_Mechs" title="Exo Mechs">Exo Mechs</a> and using the weapons that drop from them is a potential last resort should the player be struggling too much. If the player has already challenged the Exo Mechs prior to Calamitas, then their drops are typically fantastic options for her fight.</li></ul>
<h2><span class="mw-headline" id="Trivia">Trivia</span></h2>
<ul><li>The <a href="/wiki/Music" title="Music">song</a> heard during the battle against Supreme Witch, Calamitas is <a rel="nofollow" class="external text" href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MT6HTpY_OyE"><b>Stained, Brutal Calamity</b></a>, which was composed by the artist <a rel="nofollow" class="external text" href="https://www.youtube.com/user/SUPEREMERALD123">DM DOKURO</a>. This song contains full lyrics sung by a choir as well as DM DOKURO himself. Different sections of the song play as the fight progresses (at 100% / 50% / 30% / 1 boss health), each section representing a different perspective of the fight.
<ul><li>The version that plays in-game is slightly modified in order for the track to loop properly:
<ul><li>"Grief" plays from the start of the battle to the third Bullet Hell.</li>
<li>"Lament" plays from the third Bullet Hell until the fourth.</li>
<li>"Epiphany" plays from the fourth Bullet Hell until she stops attacking.</li>
<li>"Acceptance" plays when she stops attacking.</li>
<li>Grief and Lament represents Supreme Witch, Calamitas' and the player's view points respectively, Epiphany represents a 3rd voice, and Acceptance represents Supreme Witch, Calamitas' defeat.</li></ul></li>
<li>The video for this song features Alistar Kensington, also known as <a rel="nofollow" class="external text" href="https://www.patreon.com/otherbuttons">OtherButtons</a>, as a voice actor for Supreme Witch, Calamitas.</li>
<li>Despite not being composed with the same gimmick as Raw, Unfiltered Calamity, the theme contains a few motifs from past themes in Calamity's soundtrack.
<ul><li>The majority of the song contains motifs from Raw, Unfiltered Calamity (<a href="/wiki/Calamitas_Clone" title="Calamitas Clone">Calamitas Clone</a>), Now Stop Asking Where (a previous placeholder theme) and The Step Below Hell / Left Alone (<a href="/wiki/Brimstone_Crag" title="Brimstone Crag">Brimstone Crag</a> / <a href="/wiki/Brimstone_Elemental" title="Brimstone Elemental">Brimstone Elemental</a>).</li>
<li>The theme also contains motifs from two of DM DOKURO's older songs, which are not related to the Calamity Mod.</li></ul></li>
<li>Previously, her theme was a <a rel="nofollow" class="external text" href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HtGHxPIrkm8">remix of the Boss 2 theme</a> made by <a rel="nofollow" class="external text" href="https://www.youtube.com/user/silentzorah">silentzorah</a>. It was then changed to Calamitas' theme, <a rel="nofollow" class="external text" href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ysBWFTxxoak">Raw Unfiltered Calamity</a>, made by DM DOKURO. It was then changed again to an original track by <a rel="nofollow" class="external text" href="https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCPF6rg3cwhJiM8tkyI6TAIg">ENNWAY</a>, known as <a rel="nofollow" class="external text" href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oU1tRoaZe4Q">Now Stop Asking Where</a>, a reference to the fervent and frequent requests sent to DM DOKURO asking him when he would compose Supreme Witch, Calamitas' dedicated theme.</li></ul></li>
<li>While alive, Supreme Witch, Calamitas will cause cosmetic cinders to constantly rise from the bottom of the screen, with their color depending on the current phase of the fight.
<ul><li>Above 50% health, the cinders will be red.</li>
<li>Between 50% and 30% health, the cinders will be red or magenta.</li>
<li>If only Cataclysm or Catastrophe are alive in the brothers phase, the cinders will be exclusively magenta or cyan respectively.</li>
<li>Between 30% to 1% health, the cinders will be red or gold.</li>
<li>At 1 life point, the cinders will be grey or white.</li></ul></li>
<li>The person other than the player mentioned in some of her quotes is referring to the Godseeker, Yharim, whom she, along with <a href="/wiki/Permafrost" class="mw-redirect" title="Permafrost">Permafrost</a>, was allied to until at some point, as stated in the mod's <a href="/wiki/Lore" title="Lore">lore</a>.</li>
<li>Supreme Witch, Calamitas is one of only two bosses to drop a <a href="/wiki/Death_Mode" title="Death Mode">Death Mode</a>-exclusive item, the other being <a href="/wiki/The_Devourer_of_Gods" title="The Devourer of Gods">The Devourer of Gods</a>.</li>
<li>The Brimstone Flame Skulls are based on Medusa Heads from <i><a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/en:Castlevania" class="extiw" title="wikipedia:en:Castlevania">Castlevania</a></i>.</li>
<li>In older versions of the Calamity Mod, Supreme Witch, Calamitas had a hit-counter mechanic (better known as a "Hit Cap") where players could only be hit a certain number of times until they were killed instantly, regardless of damage taken. She would say "<i>You got hit too many times...noice. Did you take lessons from Leviathan?</i>" The same quote was used if the player died under the effects of Armageddon.
<ul><li>The "Leviathan" mentioned in her Armageddon/hit-cap quote is a reference to the YouTuber <a rel="nofollow" class="external text" href="https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCgzWiRT3thPJBu-veBa0y3A">Leviathan</a>, who is known for his challenges and documentation about the Calamity Mod, including numerous fights against Supreme Witch, Calamitas.</li></ul></li>
<li>Supreme Witch, Calamitas used to be a "Superboss" in this mod. In some RPG games, superbosses are extremely powerful enemies that are very challenging even if the player has endgame equipment.
<ul><li>Previous versions of the mod also had Supreme Witch, Calamitas and her brothers use upgraded sprites of their eye forms instead of the humanoid ones they have now, further tying into this.</li></ul></li>
<li>Supreme Witch, Calamitas' <a href="/wiki/Status_messages" title="Status messages">status messages</a> have the color <span style="color:#FFA500; font-weight:bold;">#FFA500 ●</span>.</li>
<li>In the previous version of the mod, Supreme Witch, Calamitas used to be unable to take any damage by any attack that would deal more than 50% of her health in one hit, such as another mod's butcher function or an incredibly powerful weapon. When hit by such an attack, the damage of the attack would be reduced to 0.</li>
<li>In previous versions of the mod, if Supreme Witch, Calamitas was killed too quickly (instantly or in less than 100 seconds), she would drop no items at all except for Omega Healing Potions as well as the Levi pet in Death Mode. Additionally, she would say "Go to hell." instead of her usual quote when killed.</li>
<li>If the <a rel="nofollow" class="external text" href="https://forums.terraria.org/index.php?threads/boss-checklist-in-game-progression-checklist.50668/">Boss Checklist Mod</a> is installed, her unique despawn message will be "The Witch vanishes, leaving nothing but stifling heat in her wake."</li></ul>
<h3><span class="mw-headline" id="Bestiary_entries"><span class="i"><a href="/wiki/Bestiary" title="Bestiary"><img alt="Bestiary" src="https://terraria.wiki.gg/images/thumb/Bestiary_icon.png/20px-Bestiary_icon.png?e5563e" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="20" height="17" srcset="https://terraria.wiki.gg/images/Bestiary_icon.png?e5563e 1.5x" data-file-width="26" data-file-height="22"></a><span><span><a href="/wiki/Bestiary" title="Bestiary">Bestiary</a></span></span></span> entries</span></h3><ul><li>Supreme Witch, Calamitas: <i>"After inheriting nigh limitless magical power as a mere teenager, she was recruited into Yharim's army, where she served for nearly a decade. But now that the fire inside her has died, all that remains are the smoldering embers of regret."</i></li><li>Cataclysm: <i>"The eldest of the three siblings, this brother was a brawler of great renown in Azafure, with few in the city being capable of matching his raw strength. He was protective of his sister, vowing to always be there for her in her times of need. The brother continues to fulfill this promise, even in death."</i></li><li>Catastrophe: <i>"The middle child of the three siblings was a skilled swordsman in life, taking up mercenary work to put food on the table. Despite his rather bloody career choice, he did his best to be kind to his sister and keep her out of any danger his occupation could have put his remaining family in. He continues to defend her, even in death."</i></li></ul>

<li>No longer uses a global scaling contact damage formula based on boss velocity.</li>
<li>Added new sounds for spawn rumble, and Cataclysm and Catastrophe's hit and death.</li>
<li>Changed the dust and particles used during her summoning animation.</li>
<li>Overhauled and improved all dust and particle visuals used during the fight, and added new dust or particle effects to almost all projectiles.</li>
<li>Forcefield now has a shine effect that faces the player while she is invincible.</li>
<li>No longer deals contact damage while not charging.</li>
<li>No longer immune to lifesteal.</li>
<li>No longer has reduced acceleration while holding a true melee weapon.</li>
<li>Now plays a sound effect to signify that a bullet hell is about to end.</li>
<li>No longer teleports to the top right corner of the arena before summoning Sepulcher.</li>
<li>Decreased fireblast's homing speed in all difficulties.</li>
<li>Fireblasts and gigablasts can now pass through tiles, and increased their dart velocity. However, they now stop moving shortly before expiring or if the player gets close to them, and have a short delay before bursting into darts.</li>
<li>Now makes all projectiles fade away when entering brothers phase or acceptance.</li>
<li>Brothers changes:
<ul><li>Now teleports above the player before spawning brothers, and they now have a new spawn animation.</li>
<li>No longer have reduced acceleration while holding a true melee weapon.</li>
<li>Reduced the size of Catastrophe's slashes.</li>
<li>Overhauled brother attacks:
<ul><li>No longer flies up and down to the side of the player while shooting projectiles horizontally and occasionally spawning rings of brimstone darts.</li>
<li>While both brothers are alive, they will alternate between flying up and down to the side of the player while firing projectiles directly at them, and standing still while firing a rapid barrage of projectiles directly at the player.</li>
<li>If a brother falls below 40% / <b><abbr class="death_value" style="cursor:pointer;" title="Death Mode">60%</abbr></b> <span class="i"><a href="/wiki/Death_Mode" title="Death Mode"><img alt="Death Mode" src="/images/thumb/Death_Indicator_%28borderless%29.png/15px-Death_Indicator_%28borderless%29.png?a97b52" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="15" height="15" srcset="/images/thumb/Death_Indicator_%28borderless%29.png/23px-Death_Indicator_%28borderless%29.png?a97b52 1.5x, /images/thumb/Death_Indicator_%28borderless%29.png/30px-Death_Indicator_%28borderless%29.png?a97b52 2x" data-file-width="46" data-file-height="46"></a></span> health or the other brother is killed, it will enter phase 2.</li>
<li>In phase 2, Cataclysm fires 2 fists around the player on every third attack, rapid fist barrage gets faster over time, and it ends the rapid fist barrage by launching an orb that spawns an extremely rapid barrage of fists in one direction. If Catastrophe is defeated, the 2 fists have a smaller spread, the fist barrage is faster, and the orb shoots fists in three directions.</li>
<li>In phase 2, Catastrophe fires a rapidly accelerating slash on every third attack, and at the end of the rapid slash barrage, lunges at the player while predicting their movement, creating a slice along the path. If Cataclysm is defeated, he spawns slashes faster, and the slice additionally creates two more slices outwards from the place where Catastrophe stopped.</li></ul></li>
<li>In Death Mode, they start attacking sooner, rapid barrage projectiles are faster, Catastrophe can always spawn a slice at the end of the attack pattern, Cataclysm fires 2 fists around the player at the end of the rapid barrage, which increases to 4 when Catastrophe is defeated, and Catastrophe's extra slices appear in a narrower spread.</li></ul></li>
<li>Now enters phase 2 after defeating brothers instead of at 40% health.</li>
<li>Brimstone Monster changes:
<ul><li>Renamed to Whispering Maelstrom.</li>
<li>Completely overhauled its visual appearance; it now resembles a swirling soul vortex instead of a static face. Previous sprite was <a href="/wiki/File:Brimstone_Monster.png" class="image"><img alt="Brimstone Monster.png" src="/images/thumb/Brimstone_Monster.png/40px-Brimstone_Monster.png?d06056" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="40" height="40" srcset="/images/thumb/Brimstone_Monster.png/60px-Brimstone_Monster.png?d06056 1.5x, /images/thumb/Brimstone_Monster.png/80px-Brimstone_Monster.png?d06056 2x" data-file-width="360" data-file-height="360"></a></li>
<li>Now spawns from the Altar of the Accursed instead of offscreen above the player.</li>
<li>Greatly increased its size, but only one Whispering Maelstrom spawns.</li>
<li>Now moves slower while Sepulcher is alive in addition to while seekers are alive, but its speed is now reduced by 20% instead of 50%.</li>
<li>Now deals constant damage to any player inside of its hitbox, which gets higher the closer the player is to its center or the faster the player is moving. This is accompanied by a burning sound and particle effects on the player. Increased Vulnerability Hex duration from 5 seconds to 6.</li></ul></li>
<li>Shield effect now gets more vibrant below 30% health, which syncs with the music.</li>
<li>Reduced the number of Soul Seekers from 20 to 10. Soul Seekers now orbit slightly closer.</li>
<li>Increased Vulnerability Hex duration from gigablasts from 3 seconds to 5, from fireblasts from 3 seconds to 4, from Cataclysm's fists from 2 seconds to 4, and from hellblasts and darts from 2 seconds to 3. Catastrophe's slashes no longer inflict Vulnerability Hex.</li>
<li>Removed her red screen shader.</li>
<li>Cinder color in the background now changes depending on phase: red while above 50% health, red to magenta between 30% and 50% health, magenta when only Cataclysm is alive, cyan when only Catastrophe is alive, red to gold between 1% and 30% health, and gray to white at 1% health.</li>
<li>Resprited. Previous sprite was <a href="/wiki/File:Brimstone_Witch_(1.5.0.001).png" class="image"><img alt="Brimstone Witch (1.5.0.001).png" src="/images/thumb/Brimstone_Witch_%281.5.0.001%29.png/27px-Brimstone_Witch_%281.5.0.001%29.png?2731e9" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="27" height="40" srcset="/images/Brimstone_Witch_%281.5.0.001%29.png?2731e9 1.5x" data-file-width="30" data-file-height="44"></a></li>
<li>Fixed forcefield having strange jumps in opacity instead of smoothly oscillating opacity.</li>
<li>Fixed darts not receiving the correct velocity due to rounding errors.</li></ul></li></ul>

<ul><li>"Do you enjoy going through hell?" (When summoned for the first time)</li>
<li>"You should have just died..." (When the fight begins after the first bullet hell)</li>
<li>"It wasn't too long ago you barely managed to defeat my doppelganger. Quite the failure, wasn't it?" (During the second bullet hell)</li>
<li>"You've harnessed great power, but you wield it for no one but yourself." (During the third bullet hell)</li>
<li>"Would you like to meet my family? Horrible, isn't it?" (When summoning Supreme Cataclysm and Supreme Catastrophe)</li>
<li>"You will suffer greatly." (When transitioning into her second phase)</li>
<li>"It's absurd to even think of trying to get away. As long as you live, you will suffer." (During the fourth bullet hell)</li>
<li>"An upstart who recklessly stole and killed their way to power. I wonder, who does that remind me of...?" (When summoning the Supreme Soul Seekers)</li>
<li>"You have no stake in this battle. No one gave you any say in this matter!" (During the fifth bullet hell)</li>
<li>"Once the dust has settled and only one remains, if it is you, what value will this have had?!" (When summoning Sepulcher for the second time)</li>
<li>The following quotes play consecutively once Supreme Calamitas is at 5% HP or lower:
<ul><li>"Just stop!"</li>
<li>"I have no future if I lose here."</li>
<li>"Once you have bested me, you will only have one path forward."</li>
<li>"And that path... also has no future."</li></ul></li>
<li>The following quotes play consecutively once Supreme Calamitas is at 1% HP or lower:
<ul><li>"Even if he has thrown all else away, his power remains."</li>
<li>"I have no more energy left to resent him, or you..."</li>
<li>"It will all be in your hands now."</li></ul></li>
<li>"If you're looking for some fourth-degree burns, you've got the right person." (When rematched)</li>
<li>"When the time comes, would you like to join my creation?" (When the rematch fight begins after the first bullet hell)</li>
<li>"You'll still have to work hard for this victory." (During the second bullet hell when rematched)</li>
<li>"I haven't had such an interesting target dummy to test my magic on in a long time." (During the third bullet hell when rematched)</li>
<li>"Empty shells of their former selves. I doubt even a scrap of their spirits remain." (When summoning Supreme Cataclysm and Supreme Catastrophe during a rematch)</li>
<li>"Here we go again." (When transitioning into her second phase during a rematch)</li>
<li>"I wonder if you've seen these in your nightmares since our first battle?" (During the fourth bullet hell when rematched)</li>
<li>"Your skill hasn't faltered in the least." (When summoning the Supreme Soul Seekers during a rematch)</li>
<li>"Isn't this exciting?" (During the fifth bullet hell when rematched)</li>
<li>"Here comes the crawling tomb, one last time." (When summoning Sepulcher for the second time during a rematch)</li>
<li>The following quotes play consecutively once Supreme Calamitas is at 5% HP or lower during a rematch:
<ul><li>"A terrific display, I concede this match to you."</li>
<li>"No doubt you will face enemies stronger than I."</li>
<li>"I trust you will not make the same mistakes he did."</li>
<li>"I can't imagine what your future holds now."</li></ul></li></ul>
